name: typewriter
title: Typewriter
description: A line types itself out, character by character, when it scrolls into view, with a caret that fades once the line is complete.

meta.reducedMotion: The whole line is there from the start, with no caret.
meta.useWhen: The concept is a terminal, a typed letter, a dispatch or a confession; one line, read once.
meta.avoidWhen: Headlines the visitor needs at once; more than one per screen; long paragraphs; anything repeated on every visit.
